text:
Evan K: New teammate hit the quickstart and got a one-off success then 402 on repeat calls. Pretty confusing for onboarding. Anyone seen this pattern?
Priya N: Yep — usually an async activation race. Which quickstart and key?
Evan K: curl quickstart from the docs, using the workspace key shown in console (ws-newteam). First run printed sample text, next run got 402.
Evan K: curl I used:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_ws_newteam_abc' \\ 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\ 
  -d '{"model":"gpt-redwood-3","input":"hi"}'
```
Evan K: Error body on failure:
```
HTTP/1.1 402 Payment Required
{"error":"billing.required","message":"Workspace API access not enabled"}
```
Marta G: SDK-bot, confirm SDK behavior here?
SDK-bot: SDKs do not auto-retry 402. First-call success then 402 usually indicates an optimistic UI or a sandbox route serving a single request before workspace activation completes.
Priya N: Our onboarding UI currently shows a green toast immediately after the user toggles "Enable API" but the backend flip is async. If the toggle job fails (rate-limit to payments provider) the flag stays false but the user sees success.
billing-bot: Billing audit for ws-newteam: api_access=false, last_activation_attempt=1767004300, activation_job=failed(rate_limit).
Evan K: For docs: can we add a short troubleshooting bullet in quickstart that tells new devs to check "API access: enabled" in workspace settings and shows the exact error text to look for? First-time users assume a single success means everything is good.
Marta G: Agreed. Also propose adding a healthcheck snippet to quickstart that calls /v1/health and fails loudly on 4xx so sample scripts don't print sample text and leave devs with false confidence.
Priya N: Good call. Filing a small docs PR and a devex ticket. Also will add a UI change request to show "Activation pending" state and attach a trace id to the toast for support correlation.
Evan K: Can we also include a short note in the SDK error wrapper that if a 402 is returned and workspace id is known, include workspace id and the raw error body in the thrown error? That speeds triage.
SDK-bot: Logged SDK change: add workspace id to error message when present, and include raw body on 4xx.
Priya N: Ops follow-up: add jittered exponential backoff to the activation job retries, and emit metric for activation_job_failures so we can alert if rate-limited.
billing-bot: Manual unblock performed for ws-newteam by Marta G: api_access=true. Activation job requeued with backoff.
Evan K: Re-ran quickstart after unblock — 200s consistently now. First successful call confirmed (for real). :tada:
Marta G: Created tickets: DEVEX-421 (docs quickstart healthcheck + troubleshooting), UI-1182 (activation pending toast + trace id), SDK-207 (error payload + workspace id).
Evan K: Thanks all. I'll add a tiny note in the onboarding checklist for new hires to verify API access explicitly until UI change ships.
Priya N: Thanks — good catch. Short-lived sandbox routes are confusing, healthcheck + explicit console verification should reduce support noise.
